SN_ITEM_COS_P_JINN_SCROLL_TT_DESC: <sml2>Genies - spirits with mysterious powers that appear in the Arabian region.  Mischievous and ill-natured, these spirits are said to be born in smoky flames.  Their muscle strength is vastly superior to that of humans, and they possess excellent intelligence.  Thus, humans put in much effort to gain their powers.  Eventually, one Muslim merchant discovered a way to a genie in a lamp, the sealed genie loyal to the human who summons it.  Now, they help and live together with humans. </sml2>
SN_ITEM_COS_P_RAVEN_SCROLL_TT_DESC: <sml2>Bird of a legend, also said to be the messenger of the sun, Three Footed Crow lives at the sun eating the flame of the sun.</sml2>
SN_ITEM_COS_P_PENGUIN_SCROLL_TT_DESC: <sml2>An animal that did not exist on the continent, it is assumed that Penguins came from the cold area in the south. Unlike their cute and small appearance, they are very aggressive. Rumors say that they suppressed the surrounding areas with brute force. </sml2>
SN_ITEM_COS_P_KANGAROO_SCROLL_TT_DESC: <sml2>Kangaroos were founded in New continent. Kangaroo was used to be a transfort pet but its ability of quickness and power of punch was outstanding. Now day, people train kangaroo as protecter from bandits.  </sml2>
SN_ITEM_COS_P_SCARY_KIDEMONAS_SCROLL_TT_:
The Kidemonas is known as a the jeweled animal. The egyptians used to decorate their shell with unvaluable jewels.
They are also very emotional, and give help to intimate humans with mysterious power.

How To Use
The time is applied when the scroll is used, and player must be level 5 or higher to be able to use.

Restriction
Cannot be summoned simultaneously with other Silk pets.
SN_ITEM_COS_P_BEAR_SCROLL_TT_DESC: <sml2>Bears used to be brutal, attacking humans and trade runs. However, some of them have been raised and trained by humans, making them an animal beneficial to humans. </sml2>
